license_required.quote: Practicing advanced or specialized, professional, or practical nursing, as defined in this part, unless holding an active license or certificate to do so.

type.quote: The Board of Nursing is created within the department and shall consist of 13 members to be appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Senate.

moral_character_required.quote: Is in good mental and physical health, is a recipient of a high school diploma or the equivalent

degree_required.value: Graduation from an approved program, accredited program, or equivalent prelicensure nursing education program
degree_required.quote: Has completed the requirements for: 1. Graduation from an approved program; 2. Graduation from a prelicensure nursing education program that the board determines is equivalent to an approved program; 3. Graduation on or after July 1, 2009, from an accredited program

accrediting_body.value: Specialized nursing accrediting agency nationally recognized by the United States Secretary of Education
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by a specialized nursing accrediting agency that is nationally recognized by the United States Secretary of Education to accredit nursing education programs

school_approval_basis.quote: accredited by a specialized nursing accrediting agency that is nationally recognized by the United States Secretary of Education to accredit nursing education programs

credential_pegged.quote: Has completed the requirements for: 1. Graduation from an approved program; 2. Graduation from a prelicensure nursing education program that the board determines is equivalent to an approved program

tiers.license_class: certified nurse practitioner (applicants graduating on or after October 1, 1998)
tiers.quote: For applicants graduating on or after October 1, 1998, graduation from a master's degree program is required for initial licensure as a certified nurse practitioner under paragraph (4)(a).

tiers.license_class: certified registered nurse anesthetist (applicants graduating on or after October 1, 2001)
tiers.quote: For applicants graduating on or after October 1, 2001, graduation from a master's degree program is required for initial licensure as a certified registered nurse anesthetist who may perform the acts listed in paragraph (4)(b).

tiers.license_class: certified nurse midwife (applicants graduating on or after October 1, 1998)
tiers.quote: For applicants graduating on or after October 1, 1998, graduation from a master's degree program is required for initial licensure as a certified nurse midwife who may perform the acts listed in paragraph (4)(c).

tiers.license_class: clinical nurse specialist (applicants graduating on or after July 1, 2007)
tiers.quote: For applicants graduating on or after July 1, 2007, graduation from a master's degree program is required for initial licensure as a clinical nurse specialist who may perform the acts listed in paragraph (4)(d).

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN (National Council of State Boards of Nursing Licensing Examination)
exams.notes: Applicants who fail the examination three consecutive times must complete a board-approved remedial course before reexamination.
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Council of State Boards of Nursing)
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: The board shall by rule prescribe up to 30 hours of continuing education biennially as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

hours_per_period.quote: The board shall by rule prescribe up to 30 hours of continuing education biennially as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

period_years.quote: The board shall by rule prescribe up to 30 hours of continuing education biennially as a condition for renewal of a license or certificate.

value: At least 3 hours on safe and effective prescription of controlled substances (for APRNs)
Prevention of medical errors (2 hours, per general chapter 456 requirements)
topical_requirements.quote: advanced practice registered nurses licensed under s. 464.012 must complete at least 3 hours of continuing education on the safe and effective prescription of controlled substances

available.quote: The department shall issue the appropriate license by endorsement to practice professional or practical nursing to any applicant who, upon applying to the department and remitting a fee set by the board in an amount not to exceed $100, demonstrates to the board that he or she meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license in another state or territory with substantially equivalent or more stringent requirements, or have actively practiced nursing in another state for 2 of the preceding 3 years without disciplinary action. Fee not to exceed $100. Florida is also a member of the Nurse Licensure Compact (eNLC), allowing multistate licensure privileges.
requirements.quote: holds a valid license to practice professional or practical nursing in another state or territory of the United States, provided that, when the applicant secured his or her original license, the requirements for licensure were substantially equivalent to or more stringent than those existing in Florida at that time

exists.quote: The Board of Nursing is created within the department and shall consist of 13 members to be appointed by the Governor and confirmed by the Senate.

national_certification.value: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCLEX examinations)
national_certification.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable.

regulatory_model.quote: Practicing advanced or specialized, professional, or practical nursing, as defined in this part, unless holding an active license or certificate to do so.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue the appropriate license by endorsement to practice professional or practical nursing

is_mandatory.quote: Practicing advanced or specialized, professional, or practical nursing, as defined in this part, unless holding an active license or certificate to do so.

title_protection.quote: A person may not practice or advertise as, or assume the title of, registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, clinical nurse specialist, certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse practitioner, or advanced practice registered nurse or use the abbreviation "R.N.," "L.P.N.," "C.N.S.," "C.R.N.A.," "C.N.M.," "C.N.P.," or "A.P.R.N." ... unless that person is licensed, certified, or authorized pursuant to s. 464.0095 to practice as such.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing advanced or specialized, professional, or practical nursing, as defined in this part, unless holding an active license or certificate to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring, attempting to procure, or renewing a license by bribery, knowing misrepresentations, or department error
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, attempting to procure, or renewing a license to practice nursing or the authority to practice practical or professional nursing pursuant to s. 464.0095 by bribery, by knowing misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or acted against by another jurisdiction's licensing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice nursing revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or entering a plea to a crime directly related to the practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of nursing or to the ability to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of specified offenses including forcible felonies, theft, fraud, lewdness, assault, child abuse, and related crimes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, any of the following offenses: 1. A forcible felony as defined in chapter 776. 2. A violation of chapter 812, relating to theft, robbery, and related crimes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or record, or failing to file a required report or record
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a false report or record, which the nurse knows to be false, intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another person to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by board rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, as defined by board rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging or attempting to engage in possession, sale, or distribution of controlled substances for other than legitimate purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging or attempting to engage in the possession, sale, or distribution of controlled substances as set forth in chapter 893, for any other than legitimate purposes authorized by this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, or chemicals or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any person known to be in violation of nursing practice laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the nurse knows is in violation of this part or of the rules of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly violating any provision of the nursing practice act, board rule, or lawful order of the board or department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly violating any provision of this part, a rule of the board or the department, or a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary proceeding or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report a licensee under chapter 458 or 459 who the nurse knows has violated disciplinary grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any licensee under chapter 458 or under chapter 459 who the nurse knows has violated the grounds for disciplinary action set out in the law under which that person is licensed and who provides health care services in a facility licensed under chapter 395

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice, including performing acts for which not qualified
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to meet minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice, including engaging in acts for which the nurse is not qualified by training or experience.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of chapter 464 or chapter 456, or rules adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, certification, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the nurse delegating such responsibilities knows or has reason to know that such person is not qualified by training, experience, certification, or licensure to perform them.

insurance_required.quote: Obtaining and maintaining professional liability coverage in an amount not less than $100,000 per claim, with a minimum annual aggregate of not less than $300,000

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional nursing means the performance of those acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and nursing skill based upon applied principles of psychological, biological, physical, and social sciences which shall include, but not be limited to: (a) The observation, assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, intervention, and evaluation of care; health teaching and counseling of the ill, injured, or infirm; and the promotion of wellness, maintenance of health, and prevention of illness of others. (b) The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed or authorized by a duly licensed practitioner authorized by the laws of this state to prescribe such medications and treatments. (c) The supervision and teaching of other personnel in the theory and performance of any of the acts described in this subsection.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance of those acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and nursing skill based upon applied principles of psychological, biological, physical, and social sciences

value: observation, assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, intervention, and evaluation of care
supervision and teaching of other personnel
methods_authorized.quote: The observation, assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, intervention, and evaluation of care; health teaching and counseling of the ill, injured, or infirm; and the promotion of wellness, maintenance of health, and prevention of illness of others.

drug_authority.value: RNs and LPNs may administer medications and treatments as prescribed by a licensed practitioner. APRNs may prescribe, dispense, administer, or order any drug within an established supervisory protocol; controlled substances only if the APRN has graduated from a master's or doctoral program in a clinical nursing specialty area. A formulary limits certain controlled substance prescribing. APRNs registered for autonomous practice may prescribe within primary care scope without supervision.
drug_authority.quote: Within the established framework, an advanced practice registered nurse may: (a) Prescribe, dispense, administer, or order any drug; however, an advanced practice registered nurse may prescribe or dispense a controlled substance as defined in s. 893.03 only if the advanced practice registered nurse has graduated from a program leading to a master's or doctoral degree in a clinical nursing specialty area with training in specialized practitioner skills.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - including Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM), Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP), Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA), Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS), and Psychiatric Nurse
Autonomous Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (registered under s. 464.0123)
license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means any person licensed in this state to practice professional nursing and who is licensed in an advanced nursing practice, including certified nurse midwives, certified nurse practitioners, certified registered nurse anesthetists, clinical nurse specialists, and psychiatric nurses.

aprn_role_categories.quote: including certified nurse midwives, certified nurse practitioners, certified registered nurse anesthetists, clinical nurse specialists, and psychiatric nurses

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: the promotion of wellness, maintenance of health, and prevention of illness of others under the direction of a registered nurse, a licensed physician, a licensed osteopathic physician, a licensed podiatric physician, or a licensed dentist

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall perform those functions authorized in this section within the framework of an established protocol that must be maintained on site at the location or locations at which an advanced practice registered nurse practices, unless the advanced practice registered nurse is registered and practicing under s. 464.0123.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: "Autonomous practice" means advanced nursing practice by an advanced practice registered nurse who is registered under s. 464.0123 and who is not subject to supervision by a physician or a supervisory protocol.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: Has completed, in any state, jurisdiction, or territory of the United States, at least 3,000 clinical practice hours, which may include clinical instructional hours provided by the applicant, within the 5 years immediately preceding the registration request while practicing as an advanced practice registered nurse under the supervision of an allopathic or osteopathic physician

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: Within the established framework, an advanced practice registered nurse may: (a) Prescribe, dispense, administer, or order any drug

value: Schedule II (limited to 7-day supply per formulary; psychiatric medications by psychiatric nurses exempt from 7-day limit)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: The formulary must also limit the prescribing of Schedule II controlled substances as listed in s. 893.03 to a 7-day supply, except that such restriction does not apply to controlled substances that are psychiatric medications prescribed by psychiatric nurses

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs are subject to the controlled substance formulary adopted by the board. The formulary limits Schedule II controlled substances to a 7-day supply (except psychiatric medications by psychiatric nurses). The formulary does not apply to controlled substances dispensed for administration pursuant to order.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The formulary must also limit the prescribing of Schedule II controlled substances as listed in s. 893.03 to a 7-day supply, except that such restriction does not apply to controlled substances that are psychiatric medications prescribed by psychiatric nurses as defined in s. 394.455.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain, or contract with or approve another entity to maintain, a state registry of certified nursing assistants.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Upon completion of the training, competency, and initial validation requirements under s. 464.2035 and this subsection, a certified nursing assistant whose delegated tasks include medication administration is designated as a qualified medication aide.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A registered nurse may delegate a task to a certified nursing assistant certified under part II of this chapter or a home health aide or a home health aide for medically fragile children as defined in s. 400.462 if the registered nurse determines that the certified nursing assistant or the home health aide is competent to perform the task

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby enacted into law and entered into by this state with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: An applicant who resides in this state, meets the licensure requirements of this section, and meets the criteria for multistate licensure under s. 464.0095 may request the issuance of a multistate license from the department.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: APRNs may use telehealth to provide health care services and may prescribe, but may not prescribe Schedule II controlled substances via telehealth except for treatment of psychiatric disorders, inpatient hospital treatment, hospice patients, or nursing home residents.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A telehealth provider may not use telehealth to prescribe a controlled substance listed in Schedule II of s. 893.03 unless the controlled substance is prescribed for the following: 1. The treatment of a psychiatric disorder; 2. Inpatient treatment at a hospital licensed under chapter 395; 3. The treatment of a patient receiving hospice services as defined in s. 400.601; or 4. The treatment of a resident of a nursing home facility as defined in s. 400.021.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Has completed, in any state, jurisdiction, or territory of the United States, at least 3,000 clinical practice hours, which may include clinical instructional hours provided by the applicant, within the 5 years immediately preceding the registration request while practicing as an advanced practice registered nurse under the supervision of an allopathic or osteopathic physician

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: The certified registered nurse anesthetist may, to the extent authorized by established protocol approved by the medical staff of the facility in which the anesthetic service is performed, perform any or all of the following

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: In order to provide out-of-hospital intrapartum care, a certified nurse midwife engaged in the autonomous practice of nurse midwifery must maintain a written policy for the transfer of patients needing a higher acuity of care or emergency services.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: The board shall establish a committee to recommend a formulary of controlled substances that an advanced practice registered nurse may not prescribe or may prescribe only for specific uses or in limited quantities.

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: Fifty percent clinical training in the United States, the District of Columbia, or a possession or territory of the United States for a practical nursing education program, an associate degree professional nursing education program, or a professional diploma nursing education program.
